text:
alex: Heads-up — noticed parity gaps in how our SDKs surface failures. Go SDK exposes typed errors (Error.Code / IsRetryable), Python currently raises generic exceptions with only message text. This is causing confusion in customers' sample apps around retry logic. Anyone already owning a cross-SDK error contract? We should make a status->retry_hint mapping and a minimal canonical error shape.
julie: Yep, just saw a support ticket where 502 from the hosted API was treated as retryable in Go but dropped in Python. Customer expectations diverge.
mike: Can you paste tiny examples? I can sketch a mapping quickly.
alex: Python example from the sample app: ```try:
    resp = client.generate(prompt)
except Exception as e:
    print(str(e))```
Go example: ```resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
if err != nil {
    if rerr, ok := err.(*redwood.Error); ok {
        switch rerr.Code {
        case "internal_error": // ...
        }
    }
}```
Users can't rely on typed checks in polyglot code.
shreya: Proposal: define a canonical error envelope with fields: "kind" (string), "code" (string), "http_status" (int), "retryable" (bool), "retry_after" (optional int seconds), "detail" (string). SDKs should normalize transport errors into that envelope and provide typed exceptions/objects. Also include a small table mapping HTTP statuses to retryable + default hint.
julie: +1. We already have an internal ErrorV2 proto for Dedicated — can we reuse that schema as the canonical shape?
ben: One caveat: streaming/partial failures (client disconnect, upstream token limit) often show up differently across transports. We need explicit rules for streaming truncation vs server error. For streaming, surface a StreamingInterrupted kind and include last_chunk_offset.
alex: Good call. Action items: create a spec PR in infra/error-contract repo with a mapping table (http_status -> code -> retryable -> default_hint) and attach three tiny sample apps (Go, Python, TS) that assert the normalized shape.
mike: I'll own the Go SDK changes + sample app tests.
shreya: I can own Python sample and update the error wrapper to raise TypedError with attributes matching the envelope. I'll include backoff guidance (exp backoff with jitter, honor Retry-After when present).
julie: Add a test matrix: SDK unit tests + sampleapp e2e that asserts parity for 429/500/502/503 and streaming interruption.
ben: For rollout: let's gate the change behind a minor version bump and a feature flag so customers can opt in before we flip behavior globally.
ops-bot: Reminder: weekly devex sync Tue 10:00 — added this to agenda (ID: 98).
alex: Thanks everyone. I'll open the spec PR and the tracking ticket. tagging @julie @mike @shreya for follow-ups. :pray:
